nodeGroups.name: Ticket rules
nodeGroups.description: Code applies the SLA: priority, due times, owner, escalation, repeats, workarounds and supplier notes.

nodeGroups.name: Draft
nodeGroups.description: Gemini writes the first response from the ticket facts, in the sender's language.

nodeGroups.name: Second attempt
nodeGroups.description: If the draft call fails (often the 15-a-minute limit), wait 45 s and try once more.

nodeGroups.name: Check and log
nodeGroups.description: Code checks the ticket number and fix-by time (else a template goes), and logs the ticket.

nodeGroups.name: Reply to the member
nodeGroups.description: Ticket acknowledgements go out without approval: threaded reply (and an Issue/P1-P4 label) for live email, a new email for test seeds.
